It is imperial belief that twins are bad omens, so Rosette Sigran was out of luck when her twin sister, Lea, was born a saint. 

Despite possessing the saint’s mark, however, it is not Lea, but Rosette who has immense divine power. She does her best to help Lea with her holy acts, but their power-hungry father only sees Rosette as a blight on the family, and so he transfers Rosette’s power to Lea and has her killed. 

Rosette then wakes up years in the past, but this time, she’s done playing nice.

A music practitioner with a dark past.  
  
A young girl with the power to create illusions.  
  
A meeting of fate.

Kyuhyun is a bullied bread shuttle in high school who dreams of breaking free from the spiral of abuse. Just the usual story. The twist? He suddenly gets introduced to a secretive crowdfunding app, "Fencer", that allows one to put bounties on bullies and if the target funding is met, anonymous hunters are dispatched to beat the shit out of them. And Kyuhyun is off to a good start, having discovered by chance the identity of "Hood", one of the strongest hunters. Between sadistic bullies, backstabbing colleagues and secret pasts, watch as he crowdfunds his way out of misery!

description.en: Just when Lee Zena was finally ready to debut as a K-pop idol, her group was scrapped because of backlash from a scandal involving Ju Siu, former member of another girl group under the same entertainment company. But after a mysterious person named "T" contacts Zena, she now sees game holograms that say her only hope of debuting is to appear on a survival idol program called "To Be Dol" with none other than Siu. As they face one mystery after another, how will Zena and Siu ever debut together?

Hosu is an average, carefree high school student who isn’t particularly special in any kind of way. Danwoo is the attractive, untouchable top student of the class. There shouldn’t really be any reason for them to interact at all. But one day, Danwoo announces that he wants Hosu to sit next to him in class. In fact, he wants to be within her presence as much as possible, and he’s willing to do whatever it takes to stay by her side. Not too close, but not too far. Just two steps away is enough. However, will they be able to maintain that distance? Come take a closer look, from just a couple steps away…

"Why does she stop mourning her husband's death and leap off a cliff?"

In this Joseon era, women were bound by the duty of serving their husbands for a lifetime...
Lady Jo Ye-hwa, the daughter-in-law of the Left State Councilor's residence, followed the "virtuous wife" path as her duty. She had lived for fifteen years after losing her husband on the day of her wedding.

During the day, she appeared as a modest young lady under the strict supervision of her mother-in-law. But at night, she became "Danju," the popular upper-class entertainer, and even played the role of a "righteous person" helping the weak. She led a double life.

On the other hand, there was Im Su-ho, a government official uninterested in advancing in society or women. He attended the Left State Councilor's 60th birthday celebration and happened to glimpse the beautiful daughter-in-law, Ye-hwa, who was known for her beauty. His heart raced unexpectedly. "Why am I feeling this way?" Furthermore, that night, he encountered a masked vigilante with incredible archery skills...

"This arrow is aimed at my heart."
"This voice... a woman?!"
The fact that this skilled and nimble vigilante was Ye-hwa was a secret!

Facing the challenges of investigation before Lady Jo Ye-hwa, a widow, and the indifferent youth Su-ho, will they overcome the obstacles and find love?

description.en:
High priestess Sia awaits her peaceful death after leading a life devoted to helping other people. Instead of finding herself next to Lord Pleon the God, she finds herself in the body of Elena, a woman known to be wicked. 

While adjusting to her new body and new life as a universally hated figure, Sia continues to encounter men she had acquainted during her day as a high priest. What's even more surprising is that those men seem to get increasingly obsessed with her.

"I am no longer the high priest on whom everyone depended, so why are these men still getting obsessed with me?!"
description.fr: La grande prêtresse Sia se prépare pour sa mort et s'apprête à rejoindre le Seigneur qu'elle sert avec loyauté depuis tant d'années. Mais à sa grande surprise, elle se réveille dans le corps d'Hélène, la cruelle duchesse d'Ernian, mal-aimée par son mari et ignorée par son personnel de maison. Confuse par cette situation, Sia se retrouve coincée entre sa vie antérieure et les personnes de son passé qui ne cessent de la pousuivre dans cette nouvelle vie.
description.id: Sia merasuki 'Elena', Seorang wanita jahat yang menipu dan menikahi bangsawan dengan dalih bisa menyembuhkan putranya. Dia yang tidak tahan dengan sikap dingin sang duke, bertekad untuk mengajukan cerai. Lebih baik hidup sebagai utusan dewa seperti dulu, daripada harus menjalani hidup seperti itu. Saat merencanakan perceraian, para pria yang dulu ditemuinya justru datang menghampiri. Wanita yang ia rasuki adalah orang jahat, kenapa semua orang terobsesi?
description.ja: 息子の病気を治すことができるとウソをついて公爵と結婚した悪女「エレナ」に転生したシア。公爵の冷遇と人々に後ろ指をさされる状況から抜け出すため、離婚することを決心した。しかし、公爵は離婚に同意してくれないし前世で縁があった男たちまで近づいてくる始末…。この体は悪女なのに、みんなどうして執着するの？
description.ko:
[악녀로 다시 태어났는데 남자들이 나를 유혹한다.] 

플레온 신전의 대신관 시아 엘브라데는 아주 오랜 세월 젊은 모습을 유지하고 있다가 수명이 다하여 죽음을 맞이한다. 그런데 다시 눈을 떴더니 에르니안 공작 부인이 되어 있었다. 
원래 몸의 주인인 엘레나 에르니안은 신력부족현상을 겪고 있던 공작의 아들을 치료할 수 있는 신력이 자신에게 있다고 사기를 쳐 결혼을 하였고, 그로 인해 사교계에서 악녀로 불리는 인물이었다.

description.zh: 落寞夫人被魂穿后反被丈夫猛烈追求！拥有不老神颜的大祭司，转生成了不受公爵待见的契约夫人。 本想躺平过一生，但反被冷傲老公疯狂求爱，与此同时，被转生前的爱慕者们猛烈追求… 这么多男人，我到底要怎么才能应付过来呀？！（不是凡尔赛）

description.en: When Sol receives an engagement party invitation from Minji, the girl who stole her first love, she's determined to attend just to prove how great she’s doing. But she needs to find a hot boyfriend first, when her dating life's been nonexistent! The only viable candidate she can find is her younger brother’s friend, Joohyuk, who has had a major glow-up since his scrawny teenage years. “I’m not a little kid anymore. You’d better watch out.” The tall, sexy Joohyuk seems like trouble…but desperate times call for desperate measures. As long as she can see Minji’s jaw drop in shock, Sol is willing to put up with his demands. Little does she know that Joohyuk is actually out to get her for ruining his life in high school! Will Sol be able to make this rocky partnership work in her favor, or will the plan backfire on her?
description.vi:
Một ngày nọ, Sol nhận được lời mời tham dự tiệc đính hôn của Minji, người đã cướp đi tình đầu của mình. Chính vì vậy, cô đã quyết tâm đến đó cho họ thấy bản thân sống tốt đến mức nào. Nhưng mà hai từ “hẹn hò” đã mất tích trong từ điển của cô từ lâu nên việc gấp rút bây giờ là phải kiếm một người thật hoàn hảo thay thế mới được!
Joohyuk là bạn thân chí cốt của em trai Sol, nhưng chỉ sau vài năm vắng bóng mà giờ đã trưởng thành đáng kể, không còn là cậu thiếu niên e thẹn gầy nhom. Và cậu ấy cũng chính lựa chọn khả thi nhất mà cô có thể tìm được.
“Tôi không còn trẻ con nữa nên tốt nhất hãy cẩn thận đi.” Joohyuk nói đầy ẩn ý, dáng người cậu cao ráo và thu hút…  Nhưng đường cùng rồi, hố có sâu thì vẫn phải nhảy. Vậy là Sol sẵn sàng chấp nhận những yêu cầu của Joohuyk cho đến lúc khiến Minji tức tối. Nhưng cô đâu có ngờ chính mình lại là người phá hoại cuộc sống thời trung học của cậu ấy, khiến Joohuyk phải ra nước ngoài. Liệu kế hoạch này có thực sự hiệu quả hay lại gậy ông đập lưng ông?

description.en:
"Wait… the male lead’s name is Hirius, and the female lead’s name is Diana…? Oh my god… Of all the novels, did I really get stuck in that horrible one?!”

Diana, the protagonist, realizes she’s been reincarnated into a novel infamous for being a chaotic mix of female-oriented romance fantasy and male-targeted fantasy—truly the worst of the worst. As if disliking the male lead wasn’t enough, she remembers that in this disaster of a novel, her character, Diana, is destined to die from exhaustion in the role of a healer after ending up with Hirius.

“No way—I refuse to die like that!”

Determined, Diana decides to test if she possesses the same overwhelming magical powers as her character does in the story, and quickly awakens her ridiculously strong abilities. Things go well enough as she impresses everyone during a magical assessment, earning a spot at the Academy—the very center of power in the empire. But there are many obstacles in front of Diana, such as Hirius and his devoted follower Arahel. Plus, her plans only get more complicated as she becomes entangled with a suspicious man named Leo, who seems to be hiding within the Academy.

Will Diana be able to achieve both power and love?
____
An ordinary girl is reincarnated as Diana, the heroine of a third-rate novel who marries the male lead and ends up dying from being overworked as a healer. Earning a spot at the Academy of Magic is just the beginning — can she sidestep the male lead and find a happy ending with Rozen, the man of her dreams?
description.fr: Avez-vous déjà voyagé dans l'une des romans que vous avez lus ? Après être devenue un personnage de livre, notre héroïne, Diana, a immédiatement commencé à rêver d'une fin heureuse, à profiter de la vie dans un nouveau monde. Tomber amoureuse du personnage principal, l'épouser, vivre heureuse jusquà la fin des temps - une histoire typique de la renaissance d'une fille, n'est-ce pas ? Quelle ne fut pas la déception de Diana lorsqu'elle réalisa qu'elle n'était pas dans une histoire d'amour, mais dans une aventure fantastique avec des monstres et une fenêtre de caractérisation ! Voulant une lie luxueuse dans un nouveau monde, Diana refuse d'accepter sa nouvelle réalité !
description.ko:
“가만… 남자주인공 이름이 히리우스에, 여자주인공이 디아나…? 맙소사… 내가 빙의한 소설이 하필이면 그 망소설이었어?!” 

자신이 빙의한 소설이 여성향 로판과 남성향 판타지가 뒤섞인 망작 중의 망작이란 것을 깨달은 주인공 디아나. 
남자주인공이 마음에 안 드는 것은 둘째치고, 이 망작 소설 속에서 여주인공 디아나는 히리우스와 맺어진 탓에 혹사당하다 사망하는 힐러 역할이란 것을 떠올린다. 

“아니, 난 절대 그렇게 죽을 수 없어!” 

그렇게 결심한 디아나는 소설 속에서처럼 자신이 막강한 마력을 지녔는지 직접 시험하기로 결심하고, 결국 쉽사리 자신의 먼치킨적인 능력을 일깨우게 된다. 
이후 마력 측정에서 막강한 마력을 뽐내며 제국 권력의 중심인 아카데미에 발을 들이게 된 것까진 좋았지만, 디아나 앞엔 히리우스와 그를 추종하는 아라헬 등 앞길을 방해하는 요소들이 수두룩하다. 
게다가 아무리 봐도 아카데미에 숨어 든 듯한 수상한 남자 레오와 엮이면서 점점 계획은 꼬여만 가는데…. 

과연 디아나는 권력과 사랑, 두 마리 토끼를 잡을 수 있을까?!
description.ru:
Вы когда-нибудь перемещались в один из прочитанных вами романов? Став персонажем книги, наша главная героиня, Диана, тут же начала грезить о счастливой концовке, наслаждаясь жизнью в новом мире. Влюбиться в главного героя, выйти за него замуж, жить долго и счастливо - типичная история о перерождении девушки, не правда ли?

Каково же было разочарование Дианы, когда она поняла, что оказалась не в любовном романе, а в приключенческом фэнтези с монстрами и окном характеристик! Желавшая роскошной жизни в новом мире, Диана отказывается принимать новую реальность!

description.en:
Natasha is an experienced divorce attorney.

And for some reason, this empire was overflowing with couples who wanted to divorce for various reasons.

For example, a husband who suddenly becomes obsessed with a wife or a wife who suddenly wants to get a divorce.

Thanks to this, Natasha was making a sizable profit by helping them.

In particular, when claiming alimony or part of property division as a fee, it was almost like sitting on a cushion of money.

‘Which lawyer would refuse this?’

Natasha hummed inwardly.

***

“…Miss Estelle. Lawyers are always on the side of their clients.”

The words that came out with a face that were not impressed were very emotional. When Estelle made a face that she couldn’t believe, Natasha continued.

“To be precise, I’m on the side of those who give me money.”

“That’s better.”

“Honesty is also a basic skill of a lawyer.”

The strongest from another world are reborn—so much for a normal life.

Old subordinates begin to gather, one by one. And the Ice Witch stands by his side—not as an enemy this time, but as a partner.

Les plus puissants d'un autre monde se réincarnent — adieu la vie normale.

Après avoir péri ensemble lors d'un ultime affrontement contre son ennemie jurée, la Sorcière des Glaces, tous deux se réincarnent sous les traits de simples jumeaux dans le monde humain. Mais leur tranquillité est de courte durée. Maintenant qu'ils sont adolescents, des organisations de Réincarnés ébranlent le monde. Ces dernières refusent de laisser la fratrie en paix, alors même qu'ils tentent de dissimuler les pouvoirs de leurs vies antérieures. D'anciens subordonnés commencent à se rassembler, un par un. Et la Sorcière des Glaces se tient à ses côtés — non plus en tant qu'ennemie, mais comme partenaire.

Le Démon Céleste parviendra-t-il à redevenir le plus puissant du monde ?!

description.en: Mirabel is a famed mercenary whose mother, Cornelia, had long suffered from the guilt of leaving her family, the Grand Duchy of Citron behind. After Cornelia's failed attempts to contact her family left her distressed and led to her death, Mirabel sought revenge, tracking down her grandfather, Grand Duke Citron, and the assumed cause of all her mother's misery. After finding out that he too was betrayed, Mirabel meets an untimely death at the hands of the true culprit, only to wake up back when she was nine years old, with her mother still alive. Determined to stop her mother's death, and seek revenge against the true villain, Mirabel sets out to make things right. But her choice to meet her grandfather makes her cross traces of her past, while she experiences a life she never knew before.

description.ja:
母は帝国でたった1人の、大公家の失踪した娘だった。
しかし、大公が娘を捜そうとした時には母はすでに死んでおり、残されたのは14年間放置され続けた私だけだった。

「閣下。残念ですが、コーネリア・クライトンは死にました」
「コーネリアが死んだ……？君は一体……」

正体を隠し、静かに去ることが、大公への復讐になると思った。
しかし、目的を果す前に私は殺されてしまった。
それも、母が苦しみの中で死を迎えるように仕向けた者が大公の弟、つまり自分の大おじであったことを知った直後に。

ところが、死んだはずの私はどういうわけか、母が生きていた9歳の頃に回帰転生してしまった。
だから私は今度こそ母を守り、気の毒な祖父も救おうと決心したのだが、大公家の様子がどうもおかしい。
クライトン大公もおじといとこも、私に甘々過ぎるのだ。
その上、傭兵王まで恩を返すためだと言って、やってきた。
私はただ、お母さんを守り、幸せに暮らしたかっただけなのに……！

누구보다 축구를 사랑하는 송유준, 갑자기 색맹이 되어 축구를 그만두게 된다. 그렇게 15년이 흐르고, 억울하게 생을 마감하게 된다.

"딱 한 번만 필드에서 뛸 수 있다면...!"

그 찰나, 15년 전 색이 보이던 시절로 돌아간다. 다시 축구를 할 수 있다는 기쁨에 공을 차려던 그 순간, 갑자기 이상한 빛이 보이기 시작한다.

경기의 흐름을 알려주는 여러 색이 보이면서 천재 미드필더로 거듭나는스포츠 현대 판타지!
description.pt-br: Song Yoo-joon, que ama futebol mais do que qualquer outra pessoa, de repente se torna daltônico e precisa abandonar o esporte. Quinze anos se passam e ele morre de forma injusta. "Por favor... Só mais uma vez em campo..." Naquele momento, ele retorna aos dias em que conseguia ver cores há 15 anos. Enquanto se prepara para chutar a bola, cheio de alegria com a perspectiva de jogar futebol novamente, de repente começa a ver luzes estranhas. Uma fantasia esportiva moderna onde ele se torna um meio-campista genial ao ver as várias cores que revelam o fluxo do jogo!

description.en:
The story is about Yugi, a very popular guy who loves to fight. He always has the same mysterious dreams, about people of a different era and a woman called Gai. After a car crash, he gets those dreams more often and even in broad daylight. Yugi wants assurance and visits a fortuneteller club.  
  
Note: Version 2 of the manhwa under the same name with different artwork and re-written story.
description.es:
La historia es sobre Yugi, un tipo muy popular al que le encanta pelear. Siempre tiene los mismos sueños misteriosos, sobre gente de otra época y una mujer llamada Gai. Después de un accidente de coche, tiene esos sueños más a menudo e incluso a plena luz del día. Yugi quiere asegurarse y visita un centro de adivinación.  
  
Nota: Una segunda versión del manhwa con el mismo nombre con diferentes ilustraciones y una historia reescrita.

That's exactly what happened to Dodam, an agent working for the NSO, the most secretive government organization. Dodam's mission? To expose an industrial spy. description.en:
In the era after the Battle of Mount Hyjal, the world attempts to recollect itself from the onslaught left in the wake of the Burning Legion.   
  
The world thought it finally would be at peace. However, when an immense power emanates throughout the land all eyes turn in search of its source. Kalecgyos, a member of a decimate race of blue dragons quests towards the elven kingdom of Quel'Thalas in search of answers but he will have to deal with a vengeful dwarf… the army of the Undead Scourge… and the unveil the mystery behind a peasant girl with an enchanting mystery before he can finally obtain what he seeks.

Kihyun ends up in the school dorms after his family loses all their money. But his dream of being successful studying silently is destroyed by Go Seungjo, who always leads a group of journalists. Go Seungjo is the son of the president and the little brother of a celebrity. Due to Seungjo's uniqueness and superiority, Kihyun faces all kinds of suffering, shame, insults and problems...

description.pt-br: “Eu sou extremamente sortudo, se você trouxer uma noiva digna da minha sorte, eu pensarei a respeito.” Uma mulher terrivelmente azarada, Haneul. Tudo o que ela queria era uma 'rotina pacífica'. Naquela alva noite nevada, um homem estonteantemente lindo apareceu diante de Haneul, Jinmong. Os dois pensaram que eram um sonho, e, sem perceberem que estavam enganados, tomaram os lábios um do outro, entrelaçaram seus corpos, e compartilharam afeição. Jinmong estava tentando virar o mundo de ponta cabeça por ela, que finalmente havia sido encontrada! Jinmong, que fumava um cigarro longo disse. “Não é isso que eu queria estar tragando.” “Eu gosto de garotas que choram dessa forma para se tornar minha noiva.” O cigarro termina de queimar. A imagem da garota chorando passa por sua mente. Eu gostaria de ver novamente.

When Selina accidentally regains her memories of her previous life, she is horrified to discover that she is related to the infamous Croft family and tries to stay away from them.

Louis, the second male lead, relentlessly pursued the female lead in the story. She tries to avoid him, but for some reason, he takes a keen interest in her, claiming that Selina has made the sound in his ears go away.

'I'm not the one you're going to obsess over, am I?'

The murderous but comically charming couple and their bizarre cohabitation begins!

---
A bad fall awakened Selina Elsner to the truth… she’s been reborn into a novel! It also gave her a cruel realization—she's a no-name side character! She barely even had any lines! As if that's not bad enough, Louis Bloomberg, the evil lord of the magic tower, fancies her! He’s a sorcerer so powerful that his magic speaks darkness in his mind! But one touch from Selina and all the voices would go away! Is that why he's obsessing over her instead of the real main character of the novel?
